titulo: Shall we go to the concert?
intro: Suggesting a plan, accepting, turning it down with an excuse, and fixing the time and place.
p.entrada.consejo: For a show you say «entrada»; for a train, «billete». It is also the door you enter by.
p.concierto.consejo: C before e sounds «th» in Spain: «kon-THYER-to».
p.obra de teatro.consejo: You say «una obra de teatro» or just «una obra». It is feminine.
p.exposición.consejo: It ends in -ción, so it is feminine: «una exposición». It sounds «eks-po-si-THYON».
p.película.consejo: It has an accent on the i: «pe-LI-ku-la». You say «ver una película».
p.teatro.consejo: The e and the a are in different syllables: «te-A-tro».
p.cine.consejo: C before i sounds «th» in Spain: «THI-ne». You say «ir al cine».
p.qué tal si.consejo: It is followed by the present: «¿qué tal si vamos al cine?». It is a friendly suggestion.
p.por qué no.consejo: With a verb in the present it is a suggestion: «¿por qué no vamos?».
p.buena idea.consejo: It is a short, friendly answer that means yes.
p.tengo planes.consejo: It is a polite excuse for saying you cannot. It is often said «es que tengo planes».
p.cómo quedamos.glosa: where and when shall we meet
p.cómo quedamos.consejo: Here «quedar» means meeting: «¿cómo quedamos?» asks when and where.
p.otro día.consejo: It is used to refuse politely: «mejor otro día».
p.billete.consejo: In Spain it is for the train or plane. In many Latin American countries it is «boleto».
b1.texto:
To suggest:

- **¿Vamos a**…**?**
- **¿Por qué no** vamos al teatro**?**
- **¿Qué tal si** vamos al cine**?**
- **¿Te apetece** + infinitive**?**

To accept: **Vale.** **Buena idea.** **Perfecto.** **Me apetece mucho.**

To refuse politely you give a reason and another plan: **Lo siento, es que** tengo planes. **¿Y si** vamos mañana**?** **Mejor otro día.**

For a real possibility: **si + present**: **Si tienes tiempo, vamos al cine.** You do not use the future after **si**.

To fix the details: **¿Cómo quedamos? ¿A qué hora? ¿Dónde?** **Quedamos a las siete en la puerta del teatro.**

For a show you ask for **una entrada**; for a train, **un billete** (in many Latin American countries, **boleto**).
b2.f0.texto: Why don't we go to the concert on Friday?
b2.f2.texto: There is a very good play on Saturday.
b2.f6.texto: Where and when shall we meet?
b2.f7.texto: Let's meet at seven at the door of the theatre.
b4.texto:
To suggest a plan you use the **present**:

- **¿Por qué no vamos** al teatro?
- **¿Qué tal si vamos** al cine?

To accept: **Vale**, **Buena idea**. To refuse: **Lo siento, es que** + reason.

A real condition takes **si + present**: **Si tienes tiempo, vamos al cine.** Never **si tendrás**.

To arrange to meet: **¿Cómo quedamos?** and **Quedamos a las siete.** The time takes **a las** (one o'clock: **a la una**).
b4.e0.texto: We go to the cinema on Saturday.
b4.e2.texto: I have a ticket for the theatre.
b5.f0.texto: The square fills with people before the concert.
b5.f1.texto: The coloured lights hang between the trees like small stars.
b5.f2.texto: Pablo waits at the door of the theatre with the two tickets.
b5.f3.texto: A group of young people laughs and sings next to the fountain.
b5.f4.texto: The warm night air brings a smell of hot bread.
b5.f5.texto: Lucía arrives running along the narrow street.
b5.f6.texto: The two of them enter the dark hall together.
b5.f7.texto: A soft silence falls over the full hall.
b5.f8.texto: The first note of the piano shines in the air like a drop of water.
b5.f9.texto: Lucía smiles at Pablo in the dim light and listens happily.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Well done! The fixed phrase is «¿qué tal si…?».
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Qué tal que» is not used here. The phrase is «qué tal si».
b6.o2.refuerzo: «Qué tal de» is not the suggestion. It is «qué tal si».
b7.o0.refuerzo: It is very direct. Better give a reason and apologise.
b7.o1: Lo siento, es que tengo planes.
b7.o1.refuerzo: Yes! It apologises and gives a reason.
b7.o2.refuerzo: «Buena idea» accepts the plan: it is a yes, not a no.
b7.pregunta: Which is a polite way to say no?
b8.traduccion: Where and when shall we meet on Saturday
b9.o0.refuerzo: For the train you ask for a billete, not an entrada.
b9.o1.refuerzo: The bill is another thing. The entrada is for getting in.
b9.o2.refuerzo: That's it! With the entrada you can get into the show.
b10.o0.refuerzo: Correct! After «por qué no» comes the verb in the present.
b10.o1.refuerzo: «Ir» is an infinitive. Here you need a conjugated verb.
b10.o2.refuerzo: «Yendo» is a gerund. Here you need a conjugated verb.
b10.pregunta: Which verb form follows «por qué no»?
b11.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «Shall we meet at seven?».
b12.o0.refuerzo: Well done! It is direct and polite.
b12.o1.refuerzo: That is the opposite: you accept the opinion.
b12.o2.refuerzo: «Buena idea» accepts a suggestion. It is not a disagreement.
b12.pregunta: Which phrase says you do not agree?
p.compras.consejo: From «comprar». The «m» before «p» is pronounced as «m».
p.corriendo.consejo: The «rr» in the middle of a word is strong. The «ie» is a diphthong.
p.entran.consejo: From «entrar». The stress is on the first syllable: «EN-tran».
p.gota.consejo: The «g» before «o» is hard: «GO-ta». Think of a drop of rain.
